meta.title: Epoch times as strings are handled consistently
gaps: The available vocabulary does not provide a way to distinguish an epoch token supplied as a numeric value from the same token supplied as a string value.
The plan cannot assert that both forms are accepted identically or that a refused string includes a readable error message.
The second extension may overwrite the first rather than expose a comparable response from both forms.
the case reads as “it is refused”, but the plan checks “it is accepted”
